title: WPMS/1120/2017 of Noor Hasan Vs Administrator/district Magistrate Nagar Panchayat Selakui AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No.1120 of 2017
Hon'ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
 Mr. Siddhartha Sah, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. Anurag Bisaria, Standing Counsel for
the State/respondent nos. 1 and 3.
 Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for the
private respondents.
 This matter has become infructuous as
during the pendency of the present writ petition
some new developments have taken place.
 Learned counsel for the petitioner
Mr. Siddhartha Sah though argues that the
petitioner has a fresh cause of action in terms of
the fresh developments which have taken place.
 In view of the above, the writ petition is
dismissed as infructuous.
 However, it is made clear that the
dismissal of this writ petition will not prejudice
the rights of the petitioner to file a fresh writ
petition in case the occasion so arises.
